_meta.author: Agent Task5
_meta.method: Adjudicate AMBIGUOUS cases in the highest-weight strata against the README decision rule (AGENT_REACHABLE requires a path from an agent/tool/model-controlled boundary; web-route-only and internal-code-only paths are NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE; sample-app/build-script code is NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE). High-weight strata were inspected by fetching the pinned source from GitHub for the top 6 cases; the remaining 10 sample-app and clear-internal-helper cases were adjudicated on the prior labeler's verified evidence text plus the decision rule.
_meta.note: Every adjudication moved AMBIGUOUS to NOT_AGENT_REACHABLE. No AMBIGUOUS case was upgraded to AGENT_REACHABLE. The high end of the bracket (52%) is therefore unchanged; only the low end moves. The remaining 12 AMBIGUOUS cases (60 weighted) are unresolved-framework paths where static analysis genuinely cannot decide without a runtime trace; they were left as AMBIGUOUS.

remaining_ambiguous_reasons: All remaining AMBIGUOUS carry reason=unresolved_framework or unresolved_input; the prior labeler flagged these as 'cannot determine from static analysis alone'. They are left as AMBIGUOUS rather than adjudicated, because no fetched source established an agent boundary for any of them. These are genuinely undecidable from static analysis and require a runtime trace.
forbidden_metrics_not_introduced: No authority coverage, % protected, % safe, or any figure dividing findings by an estimate of total consequential actions. The bracket's denominators are fully observed on the detected side (149 reachable sinks, weighted-by-design on the missed side) and the AMBIGUOUS bucket is a weighted sum of explicitly-labelled sample rows, not an estimate of total actions.
